auditor_scope: A source-page snapshots and C public metadata feasibility; aggregates only

privacy_and_access.lumiere_method: HTTP range requests for ZIP tail/central directory and README metadata; no ZIP member containing image pixels was decompressed or read.

local_metadata_artifact.description: 10,000,000-byte ZIP tail obtained by HTTP range; contains EOCD/ZIP64 metadata but is not the full archive
local_metadata_artifact.note: The HTTP range may contain trailing compressed bytes preceding the central directory. Only directory records were parsed; image members were not opened or decompressed.

sources.counting_rule: Parse ZIP central-directory path names only. Count Patient-XXX directories and Patient-XXX/week-XXX study directories. A study directory is complete only if it contains all four base filenames CT1.nii.gz, T1.nii.gz, T2.nii.gz and FLAIR.nii.gz. For the conservative patient count, collapse suffixes such as week-000-1 and week-000-2 to one nominal week number, then require at least four distinct nominal weeks. No file contents or patient images were read.
limitations: Derived counts do not prove four clinically usable visits, two past plus two future visits, adequate horizon spacing, expert lesion-mask availability, treatment-timeline completeness, or prefix-safe preprocessing.
LUMIERE time is represented by anonymized relative week counts; actual calendar days are not asserted.
The remote whole-archive SHA256 was not computed because bulk image download was prohibited; only the local metadata artifact hash is supplied.

local_metadata_artifact.description: Downloaded README PDF only; no patient images

sources.counting_rule: No counts derived from PDF text; used only to verify public file layout, file names, metadata categories and access notes.
limitations: API labels CC0 but README says non-commercial use; unresolved source conflict, no legal adjudication or DUA acceptance in this audit.
README access/use wording must be checked against the current institutional terms before any data use.
README does not establish patient-level mask quality or two-past/two-future usability.

sources.counting_rule: Parse CSV rows and group by dataset. Treat n_times as the field supplied by this derived DCE release, then report its distribution without reinterpreting it as treatment-visit depth. README/code inspection identifies these as within-exam contrast phases, so no longitudinal T0-T3 count is derived.
limitations: The repository README and snapshot totals are not perfectly consistent (README describes approximately 2,072 while this CSV has 2,070 rows); keep release total/version as UNKNOWN until resolved.
n_times is intra-exam DCE phase count, not evidence of two past plus two future clinical visits.
This is a derived resource and does not by itself verify original I-SPY2 subject-level completeness, treatment timestamps or trial-grade FTV labels.

sources.is_public_at_audit: paper points to public TCIA collection; access snapshot not independently completed
sources.counting_rule: No manifest was downloaded. Use the paper's explicit t0, t1 and t2 timeline description only; do not infer a four-visit cohort from 264 patients or pair counts.
limitations: Three named timepoints cannot satisfy a two-past plus two-future protocol for one patient.
No patient-level four-visit intersection was claimed or counted.

sources.counting_rule: No clinical CSV or patient manifest was downloaded. Record only the protocol-level T0/T1/T2/T3 statement. Do not convert collection totals or within-exam DCE phases into all-four visit counts.
limitations: The data dictionary says not all objects are present in all cases due to unanalyzable studies.
Timing fields are best effort from DICOM metadata; exact patient-level visit completeness and usable FTV intersection remain UNKNOWN.

sources.counting_rule: No OASIS manifest or clinical table was downloaded. Record only that the official FAQ describes MR_d1234-style days-from-entry identifiers; do not infer depth from the resource name.
limitations: No subject-level count, segmentation intersection, protocol continuity or permission snapshot was established in this audit.

independent_recount.role: root integration; independent counting implementation on the same retrieved metadata, not an independent data acquisition

page_level_A_sources.scope: Source-page/README transcription only; no per-patient image/header/manifest audit. Hash checks concern downloaded public source pages, not dataset contents.
counting_policy: Use only explicit aggregate counts stated by the source; do not infer patient counts from video/frame totals.
Retain qualifiers such as 'over' and report conflicts between dataset-card prose, split tables, and update notes.
A current README on a moving branch is versioned as a dated snapshot plus SHA256; this is not a claim of immutable dataset content.
A label at ED/ES or sparse challenge frames is not counted as dense future labels.
No continuity, timestamp, treatment, pose, force, or action property is inferred unless the source explicitly states it.

records.public_access_and_license: HF dataset card states CC-BY-NC-4.0. Training release is public; README update says preliminary/final testing became downloadable in January 2026 except cohort D due privacy, while earlier prose says 58 labeled test cases are submission-only. Treat access as version/conflict requiring recheck.
